Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. Your only job is to send feedback and criticism (compute 'gradients'). payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the woman’s bright pink outer jacket fully closed, and is its front opening visibly more closed than in the source?
node.criteria: complete: the jacket’s front is fully closed; partial: its front is visibly more closed than in the source but not fully closed; absent: no visible progress toward closing the front; unknown: the front opening is genuinely occluded or indeterminate.
node.binding: Visual target: the woman’s bright pink outer jacket. Compare the jacket’s front opening and edges in the source and edited images; assess whether the front is fully closed or visibly more closed.

node_traces.evidence: The jacket’s front is visibly open in both images; in the edited image, the front panels hang apart rather than closing over the torso.
